temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt over the past few days; when Keith asks if he upset her, she says no, explains she is dealing with personal stuff, and apologizes if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth might be upset with him, possibly because of a misunderstanding or a mistake he made unknowingly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Elizabeth explicitly denies being upset with him; her curtness is due to personal stress, not anger toward him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not angry at him; she is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to be understanding and offer support if she wants to talk

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth accepts his offer of a coffee break, thanks him, and seems receptive to his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and may need someone to talk to.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Elizabeth welcomes his support and accepts the coffee break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is open to receiving his support; a coffee break may help her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to support her during the coffee break and be available to listen

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares more about her severe stresses; when Keith suggests professional help, she says she has thought about it but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is under severe stress; professional help might benefit her, but he worries about offending her by suggesting it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Elizabeth does not reject the idea outright, but she is hesitant and unsure about seeking help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Professional help could be valuable, but Elizabeth is ambivalent and hesitant, so the suggestion needs to be handled sensitively.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to gently encourage her to consider professional help without pressuring her

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after his professional-help suggestion; when he apologizes, she says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: His suggestion may have embarrassed or upset Elizabeth; he regrets possibly overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Elizabeth denies he overstepped and expresses appreciation, though she is still processing a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He did not offend her; she appreciates his concern but is overwhelmed and needs space to think.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: regretful, then relieved but still concerned
temporal_state_chain.intention: to reassure her of his support and avoid pushing the professional-help topic

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth appears more open and appreciative; she thanks him, says his support means a lot, and says she feels better knowing she has his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciates his concern but is still processing her stress and his suggestion.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Elizabeth's openness and gratitude confirm that she values his support and feels more comfortable around him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support, feels better, and is comfortable with their supportive relationship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to maintain the supportive relationship and remain available to chat or take breaks together
